svg.title: System Reminders: restate guidance late in a long run
svg.desc: SystemReminders runs in the before_model_request hook. A Reminder with interval=3 fires on requests 3 and 6. When it fires, the reminder is added at the tail of that request, after the cache breakpoint, so the cached prefix of tools, instructions and conversation is reused. The next request does not show it again.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
